text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can produce stunning paintings, compose original music, and even write poems or short stories. Some people are amazed by these results, while others worry that machines are replacing human imagination. However, there is a clear difference between human and machine creativity. A human artist brings personal emotions, memories, and cultural experiences to their work. AI, on the other hand, learns from existing data and combines patterns in new ways. It can imitate styles but does not truly feel or understand meaning. Many experts believe AI should be seen as a helpful tool, not a competitor. It can inspire us, save time, and open new possibilities. Yet, the deepest creative spark remains uniquely human.
